request: Build a small Jac web app for the 2048 tile game on a 4x4 grid. A move in one of four directions slides all tiles and merges equal neighbours once per move; the score grows by the merged values. After a move that changes the board, a new tile appears in an empty cell; the random source is injectable so tests are deterministic.
acceptance: Moving left on the row [2,2,2,2] gives [4,4,0,0] and adds 8 to the score.
A move that changes nothing spawns no tile and does not count as a turn.
The game is over only when the board is full and no two neighbours are equal; reaching 2048 sets 'won' without ending the game.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.
